name: Tartan
bio: Tartan (an Assyrian military title, used in Scripture as a name) was one of three officers — alongside Rabsaris and Rabshakeh — whom Sennacherib, king of Assyria, sent from Lachish with a great army against Jerusalem (2 Kings 18:17). The same title is used of a different officer decades earlier, sent by Sargon king of Assyria to capture Ashdod (Isaiah 20:1).
